This caused checkout-svc to retry payment-svc requests more aggressively, leading to higher upstream errors (metric:0400058a8f) and payment-svc error rates (metric:e084a75703). The checkout-svc error rate (metric:1364a73bd4) spiked to 0.3667, matching the alert condition. No contradicting evidence exists for this hypothesis.
